Here are 3 ways (that I know of) on how you can conditionally filter your where clause in T-SQL. texts.full_text: residence at 54 North Champlain Street in Burlington, Vermont. Built about 1900, it is a well-preserved example of a Queen Anne style apartment house. It was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 2014. Description and history The Robarge-Desautels Apartment House stands on the east side of North Champlain Street in Burlington's Old North end neighborhood, a short way south of its junction with North Street. It is a long rectangular 2-1/2 story wood frame structure, with a gabled roof augmented by long shed-roof dormers to provide a full living space in the attic level. Its vernacular Queen Anne features include gabled bracketed hoods over two of its entrances, which flank a central projecting polygonal bay. Thatbay is topped with an ornamental finial and has decorative shingles that add texture contrast to the smooth clapboard siding used on much of the building's exterior. The apartment house was constructed around 1900 during Burlington’s industrial boom, when many multi-family dwellings were built in response to growing demand for housing. The property reflects changes occurring within urban areas at this time as single family homes gave way to more dense and diverse living arrangements suitable for a burgeoning population of workers. The building's association with the Robarge-Desautels families is significant; they played roles both locally, contributing economically through tenancy management or ownership in an era when property investment was key economic activity within communities like Burlington’s Old North End. The listing on National Register acknowledges not only its architectural value but also socio-economic importance as a physical representation of early 20th-century urban development patterns and working-class life. All four isolates were susceptible to both agents based on individual MIC values. To determine the bactericidal activity of these two antibiotics, the MBC:MIC ratios were calculated for each isolate. The MBC is defined as the lowest concentration at which 99.9% of the bacterial population is killed after a period (usually 1 hour). texts.full_text: cept takes users into the open and dynamic spaces of the building’s inside. The urban block features three-dimensional cuts on the side facing the park, which creates a contemporary, clear structure, blurring the boundaries between exterior and interior. The cuts draw the user into the interior of the building, both to revive the city space and to create naturally emerging entrance situations. The ground floor is divided into three regions: First the lobby providing the main entrance, orientated towards the Alexanderufer street, from where all areas of the building can be accessed. Second the café which is interwoven with the park space and third the staff and delivery zone towards the busy Margarete-Steffin Street. Upon entering the lobby the spatial program opens up in a natural way: the building-high atrium space provides clarity, visual connections and guidance. It allows for reaching the floor above, where the event area, a special exhibition and the internal office area are located. The top floor houses the main show, the gallery spaces and theme islands. Here, an additional lighting through skylights in the ceiling area is provided. The floor plan provides flexible spaces for different types of use. The perforation of the wall Creates vistas and offers a fantastic view over the city. The facade of the building consists of a metal skin, which gives the building’s form a homogeneous appearance. The spaces within the wall are filled with glass and solar modules, which feed the household energy system - a link in a regional smart grid system is possible, which is a urban energy storage offering the possibility to deliver and to store on the fly. Therewith the HdZ acts as didactic interface for a futuristic smart grid technology. The spherical shaped bottom side of the building consists of a fully mirrored surface to lead bright daylight into the covered parts of the open ground floor. Exposed to the harsh weather conditions on the river, the metal facade will develop a fascinating patina over time. 1 / 2 / 3 / 4

Define a sequence of bump functions: Construct a sequence of bump functions $\phi_n$ that are $1$ on a large ball centered at the origin and $0$ outside a slightly larger ball. These functions can be made smooth (infinitely differentiable) if desired, but continuity suffices for this argument. 2. Multiply $f$ by $\phi_n$: Define a sequence of functions $f_n = f \cdot \phi_n$. Each $f_n$ will have compact support and will agree with $f$ on the support of $\phi_n$. 3.
